description: Admission, risk, status and count rules for the catalog. Consumed by normalize/aggregate gates.

admission.comment: A candidate becomes listed only after a curation PR satisfies all of the above. Auto-discovery never promotes to listed.

discovery.non_plugin_handling: discovered but is_plugin=false → kept as candidate with is_plugin=false (Radar records everything found; Catalog never lists non-plugins)

shrinkage_guard.comment: If candidate total < 95% of last published total, the run fails closed (source incomplete).

platform_repositories.deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness: harness 本体（被测基座），非插件——装测必败，判定无意义，排除出目录与统计

tombstone.readd_policy: blocked — a tombstoned id that reappears is NOT auto-relisted; requires an explicit curation PR explaining restoration.
